title: 标准格式 · 混合题型

items.question: She ____ to the theatre last night.
items.explanation: last night 是过去时间状语，用过去式 went。
think 的过去式是 thought，不是 thinked。

items.passage: Last week I {{1}} to the theatre. The man behind me was talking {{2}}.

blanks.explanation: Last week 提示过去时，选 went。
修饰动词 talking 要用副词 loudly。
